rules.title: San Francisco annual allowable rent increase
rules.requirement: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase is 1.6% from March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 (1.4% the prior year).
rules.coverage_conditions: Rent-controlled units under the Rent Ordinance (certificate of occupancy on or before 1979-06-13)
rules.quoted_span: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.

notes: News page on the annual rate; the 1979-06-13 coverage cutoff comes from the task context and D079's mention of post-June 13, 1979 certificates, not from this page.
